meta.title: Summary - 2 Intake & Scoping
meta.description:
# 2 Intake & Scoping

**Who:** Scott Riggsbee (Elliott, Client Services Director) takes the order himself; Ana Ruiz comes back once.
**Story:** Scott picks 610696 off the Unassigned tab, assigns it to himself, acknowledges it, asks Ana for the rent roll and sends her the description of work. Ana signs in, uploads the rent roll and approves the description of work; Scott is emailed.

| Col | Step |
|---|---|
| A–C | OrderNumberAssigned (copy, chapter 1), InProgressOrders, ShippedOrders (empty) and UnassignedOrders → **Scott's dashboard**: three stacked lists, Unassigned (1), In progress and Shipped empty, View (blue) |
| D–E | OrderDetails → **Order page, Submitted** → AssignOrder → **OrderAssigned** (Assign to me) |
| F | **UnassignedOrders** original (the order leaves the tab) |
| G–H | **Order page, Assigned** → AcknowledgeOrder → **OrderAcknowledged** |
| I–K | **Order page, Acknowledged** (Request documents) + DocumentTypes → **Request documents dialog** → RequestClientDocuments → **ClientDocumentsRequested** (Rent roll, requestId) |
| L–M | DocumentRequestNoticesToSend → **Document Request Notifier** → email to Ana |
| N–O | **Order page with the open request** → **Description of work editor** (rich text) → SubmitDescriptionOfWork → **DescriptionOfWorkSubmitted** (descriptionOfWorkId, version 1) |
| P–Q | DescriptionOfWorkSubmittedNoticesToSend → **Description of Work Approval Notifier** → email to Ana |
| R | ClientOrders → **Ana's Home**: 610696 DoW awaiting approval, View (blue) |
| S–T | ClientOrderDetails → **Ana's order page** (Upload) → **upload dialog** → ProvideRequestedDocument → **RequestedDocumentProvided** (Rent roll; closes the request) |
| U–V | **Ana's order page** (Approve) → **approval dialog** → ApproveDescriptionOfWork → **DescriptionOfWorkApproved** |
| W–X | DescriptionOfWorkApprovedNoticesToSend → **Description of Work Approved Notifier** → email to Scott |
| Y | **Ana's order page, DoW approved** (last screen, no mark) |

Rejections: assign twice, acknowledge before assigned, request before acknowledged, empty description of work, upload with no open request or twice, approve with nothing to approve or twice, duplicate notices.

## Conventions
- **Order page per viewer:** OrderDetails (Elliott staff), ClientOrderDetails (client), VendorOrderDetails (vendor). Each page's **timeline is a list field of its own read model** (one read model per page, simplest for the build kit).
- **Order statuses** (same everywhere): Draft | Submitted | Assigned | Acknowledged | DoW awaiting approval | DoW approved | Vendor assigned | Inspection scheduled | Inspection completed | Report delivered | Shipped. The vendor only sees its part; the client sees "Appraiser assigned" instead of the vendor's name.
- **Notifications:** every email is an automation: to-do list → notifier → Send…Notice → …NoticeSent (closes the to-do). Emails land in MailPit.
- **Master-detail:** lists offer View; actions sit on the order page and show only when the status allows them.
- Ids only on events (names from UserDirectory); the header has a Home link on every screen; blue marks on the next click, none on a chapter's last screen.

## Ids and streams
- **Id format:** every id is a String "<tenant>|<key>" with a short readable key (e.g. elliott|7304, elliott|c8e41a7d); the order id is the one full GUID (elliott|9b2f3c1e-5d7a-4e8b-a1c4-0d6e8f2a7b31), on purpose. Versions are Int, the order number Long, dates Date, timestamps DateTime, fees Decimal.
- **Stream names:** "<kind>-<tenant>|<key>" (documentation only, not a field):
  - Order: order-elliott|9b2f3c1e-5d7a-4e8b-a1c4-0d6e8f2a7b31 (assignment, acknowledgement, document request, description of work all on the order stream)
- **Correlation ids inside the order stream:** requestId elliott|3f8a6d52, descriptionOfWorkId elliott|5e1a7c20 (+ version). initiatedBy: Scott elliott|3005, Ana elliott|7304, notifiers elliott|0a1b2c03 / 0a1b2c04 / 0a1b2c05.

meta.title: Summary - 4 Ship
meta.description:
# 4 Ship

**Who:** Scott Riggsbee.
**Story:** Scott was emailed that the report is in; he starts on his dashboard, opens 610696 from In progress and marks it shipped. Ana is emailed that her report is ready. This is the end of the demo.

| Col | Step |
|---|---|
| A–C | Copies of TenantUserAdded (seed), BorrowerAndAccessContactSaved and OrderSubmitted (chapters 0–1): assignee name, access contact and who entered the order, for OrderDetails and InProgressOrders |
| D–N | Copies of the order events from chapters 1–3 (number, assigned, acknowledged, request, description of work, provided, approved, vendor assigned, inspection scheduled/completed, report delivered) - they define the read models whose last event is in this chapter |
| O–Q | UnassignedOrders, InProgressOrders (610696 Report delivered, Scott Riggsbee) and ShippedOrders (copies) → **Scott's dashboard**: View (blue) on 610696 in In progress |
| R | OrderDetails → **Order page, Report delivered** (Mark shipped) |
| S | **Ship confirmation** → ShipOrder → **OrderShipped** |
| T–U | OrderShippedNoticesToSend → **Order Shipped Notifier** → email to Ana |
| V | **InProgressOrders** original (every assigned order not shipped yet, AMC-wide, with who it is assigned to; a shipped order leaves it) |
| W | **ClientOrders** original (Ana's My orders; moved here from chapter 1, which keeps a linked copy) |
| X | **ClientOrderDetails** original (Ana's order page) |
| Y | **OrderDetails** original → **Order page, Shipped** (Home, blue, in the header) |
| Z | UnassignedOrders (copy, empty) |
| AA | **ShippedOrders** original → **Scott's dashboard**: Unassigned and In progress empty, 610696 under **Shipped** (last screen of the demo, no mark) |

Rejections: ship before the report is delivered, ship twice, duplicate notice.

**Staff dashboard:** three stacked lists for the whole AMC, each with the standard pager: **Unassigned** (UnassignedOrders), **In progress** (InProgressOrders: every assigned order not shipped yet, with an Assigned to column) and **Shipped** (ShippedOrders). The demo only ever shows Scott. Every rendering of Scott's dashboard (chapters 2 and 4) has all three.

**Client view:** the client never sees Report delivered - ClientOrders and ClientOrderDetails keep Inspection completed until OrderShipped (Shipped). Scenario: "A delivered report isn't shown to the client before shipping".

**OrderDetails** also carries the access contact, the description of work (id, version, status, text), the delivered report (document id, file name) and who entered the order (id + name), which the Assign vendor and Mark shipped dialogs read.

**Why the originals are here:** each read model's original sits in the chapter of its last feeding event (OrderShipped); earlier chapters show linked copies at their story points.

## Conventions
- **Order page per viewer:** OrderDetails (Elliott staff), ClientOrderDetails (client), VendorOrderDetails (vendor). Each page's **timeline is a list field of its own read model** (one read model per page, simplest for the build kit).
- **Order statuses** (same everywhere): Draft | Submitted | Assigned | Acknowledged | DoW awaiting approval | DoW approved | Vendor assigned | Inspection scheduled | Inspection completed | Report delivered | Shipped. The vendor only sees its part; the client sees "Appraiser assigned" instead of the vendor's name.
- **Notifications:** every email is an automation: to-do list → notifier → Send…Notice → …NoticeSent (closes the to-do). Emails land in MailPit.
- **Master-detail:** lists offer View; actions sit on the order page and show only when the status allows them.
- Ids only on events (names from UserDirectory); the header has a Home link on every screen; blue marks on the next click, none on a chapter's last screen.

## Ids and streams
- **Id format:** every id is a String "<tenant>|<key>" with a short readable key (e.g. elliott|7304, elliott|c8e41a7d); the order id is the one full GUID (elliott|9b2f3c1e-5d7a-4e8b-a1c4-0d6e8f2a7b31), on purpose. Versions are Int, the order number Long, dates Date, timestamps DateTime, fees Decimal.
- **Stream names:** "<kind>-<tenant>|<key>" (documentation only, not a field):
  - Order: order-elliott|9b2f3c1e-5d7a-4e8b-a1c4-0d6e8f2a7b31 (OrderShipped)
- **Read models** (OrderDetails, ClientOrderDetails, ClientOrders, InProgressOrders, ShippedOrders) are keyed by orderId (or listed per tenant / client user); they have no streams of their own. initiatedBy: Scott elliott|3005, the Order Shipped Notifier elliott|0a1b2c08.

meta.title: Summary - 0 Seed Data
meta.description:
# 0 Seed Data

**Why this chapter:** the demo starts with everything set up. Instead of modeling setup screens, a **seed script** inserts these events when the demo environment is created, so every read model the demo uses is still built from events (no hand-filled tables).

**Users** are pre-loaded in IdentityServer; each user id IS the IdentityServer subject (sub).

| Col | Seed event | Example |
|---|---|---|
| A | TenantRegistered | Elliott & Company (tenant elliott) |
| B | ClientRegistered | Carter Bank & Trust (clientId elliott|c8e41a7d) |
| C | ServiceRequestTypeAdded | Appraisal Commercial (elliott|5a1f0c3e, v1) |
| D | ClientUserAdded | Ana Ruiz, Commercial Loan Officer (elliott|7304) |
| E | TenantUserAdded | Scott Riggsbee, Client Services Director (elliott|3005); also the service accounts (title "Automation") |
| F | FormTypeAdded → **OrderableServices** | Market Value Interior Inspection (elliott|e5a1c9d3, v1) under Appraisal Commercial |
| G | IntendedUseAdded → **IntendedUses** | Refinance elliott|ad86c5b7, Purchase elliott|b3c94e12, Construction elliott|4c19e7a2, Other elliott|e81d3f06 |
| H | DocumentTypeAdded → **DocumentTypes** | Lease agreements, Rent roll, Operating statements, Other |
| I | VendorRegistered → **AssignableVendors** | Miller Valuation Group (elliott|61, VA) |
| J | VendorUserAdded → **UserDirectory** | Mike Miller (elliott|5701); the directory lists every user and service account |

**Structure (slim):** only the Client and its users. Elliott's service request types and form types are orderable as they are (OrderableServices).

**Conventions:** events carry ids only; names come from **UserDirectory**. Reference-list ids carry a version (service request types, form types, intended uses, document types), with the name kept next to the id.

**The script** writes one event per row of seed data (e.g. four IntendedUseAdded events); the board shows one example of each.

## Ids and streams
- **Id format:** every id is a String "<tenant>|<key>" with a short readable key (e.g. elliott|7304, elliott|c8e41a7d); the order id is the one full GUID (elliott|9b2f3c1e-5d7a-4e8b-a1c4-0d6e8f2a7b31), on purpose. Versions are Int, the order number Long, dates Date, timestamps DateTime, fees Decimal.
- **Stream names:** "<kind>-<tenant>|<key>" (documentation only, not a field):
  - Tenant: tenant-elliott
  - Client: client-elliott|c8e41a7d (Carter Bank & Trust)
  - User: user-elliott|7304 (Ana Ruiz), user-elliott|3005 (Scott Riggsbee), user-elliott|5701 (Mike Miller), service accounts user-elliott|0a1b2c00 … 0a1b2c08
  - ServiceRequestType: serviceRequestType-elliott|5a1f0c3e
  - FormType: formType-elliott|e5a1c9d3
  - IntendedUse: intendedUse-elliott|ad86c5b7 (Refinance), intendedUse-elliott|b3c94e12 (Purchase), intendedUse-elliott|4c19e7a2 (Construction), intendedUse-elliott|e81d3f06 (Other)
  - DocumentType: documentType-elliott|3e7a9c15 (Lease agreements), documentType-elliott|5f1c8e24 (Rent roll), documentType-elliott|9b4d2a71 (Operating statements), documentType-elliott|7d2e9b40 (Other)
  - Vendor: vendor-elliott|61 (Miller Valuation Group)
- **Main accounts:** clients and vendors (and their users) also have a main account outside the tenant, scoped clientacct / vendordir (e.g. clientacct|c8e41a7d, vendordir|61, vendordir|5701). Once onboarded to an AMC (or on its fee panel) they get an id in that tenant with the SAME key and the tenant slug as scope (elliott|c8e41a7d, elliott|61, elliott|5701). Orders use the tenant ids.
- **Users = IdentityServer subjects:** a user id equals its IdentityServer subject; initiatedBy is the acting user's id. Automations are users too (service accounts, title "Automation"): Seed Script elliott|0a1b2c00, Order Number Assigner elliott|0a1b2c01, New Order Notifier elliott|0a1b2c02, Document Request Notifier elliott|0a1b2c03, Description of Work Approval Notifier elliott|0a1b2c04, Description of Work Approved Notifier elliott|0a1b2c05, Vendor Assignment Notifier elliott|0a1b2c06, Report Delivered Notifier elliott|0a1b2c07, Order Shipped Notifier elliott|0a1b2c08.
